Pew study projects faster growth for Muslims than Hindus globally and in India

A Pew Research Center study projecting global religious demographics between 2020 and 2070 forecasts that the Muslim population will grow by 80% worldwide, while the Hindu population will grow by 17%. The study indicates that India's Muslim population is projected to grow at a faster pace than its Hindu population, though India will remain predominantly Hindu. The projections suggest that by 2070, the global Hindu population's share of the world's population will decline, while the Muslim population's share will increase. The study also projects that India and Pakistan will lead in Muslim population rankings.
